Deconvolve spots read in windows

Source: R/dwls.R
dwls_stream.Rd

The spatialDWLS driver for expression backends that read spots in windows, such as an on-disk store. dwls() calls it with a single window.

The reader is called once per window in each of four passes: cluster and feature means, PAGE z-scores, the cluster round of solves and the spot round. Only the signature features are ever requested, and no more than one window is held at a time (apart from the cell types x spots result).

Usage

dwls_stream(
  read_window,
  n_windows,
  feat_ids,
  clusters,
  sign_matrix,
  n_cell = 50,
  cutoff = 2,
  logbase = 2,
  na_as_zero = FALSE,
  BPPARAM = NULL,
  chunk_size = 256L
)

Arguments

read_window

function(i, features) returning the log-scaled expression of window i (1..n_windows) for exactly features, in that order, as a features x spots matrix or Matrix with spot IDs as column names. It must return the same spots for the same i on every pass, in any order.

n_windows

integer. number of windows.

feat_ids

character. every feature the backend holds; the signature is restricted to these.

clusters

cluster of every spot, named by spot ID. Extra entries are ignored.

sign_matrix

mean expression per cell type: signature features (rows) by cell type (columns), on the reverse-logged scale, e.g. from dwls_signature(). Not a binary marker matrix.

n_cell

numeric. expected number of cells per spot. In round 2 a cell type is kept for a spot only when its round-1 proportion is at least 1 / n_cell.

cutoff

numeric. PAGE enrichment z-score a cell type must reach in at least one spot of a cluster to be a candidate for that cluster. The two highest-scoring types are always candidates.

logbase

numeric. log base of expr.

na_as_zero

logical. spots that cannot be solved (no signal on the signature features) are NA by default; TRUE returns them as 0.

BPPARAM

a BiocParallel::BiocParallelParam for the per-cluster plans and per-spot solves, or NULL (default) to run serially.

chunk_size

integer. spots per parallel task.

Value

a numeric matrix, cell types (rows) by spots (columns), spots in window order.

Examples

set.seed(1)
genes <- paste0("g", 1:30)
sig <- matrix(1, 30, 3, dimnames = list(genes, c("A", "B", "C")))
sig[1:10, "A"] <- sig[11:20, "B"] <- sig[21:30, "C"] <- 40
mix <- cbind(rbind(a <- runif(20, 0.3, 0.7), 1 - a, 0),
             matrix(c(0, 0, 1), 3, 20))
expr <- log2(matrix(rpois(30 * 40, sig %*% mix * 5), 30,
                    dimnames = list(genes, paste0("s", 1:40))) + 1)
clusters <- setNames(rep(c("mixed", "pure"), each = 20), colnames(expr))

# read the spots ten at a time
windows <- split(colnames(expr), rep(1:4, each = 10))
prop <- dwls_stream(
    read_window = function(i, features) expr[features, windows[[i]]],
    n_windows = length(windows), feat_ids = rownames(expr),
    clusters = clusters, sign_matrix = sig, n_cell = 5
)
all.equal(prop, dwls(expr, sig, clusters, n_cell = 5))
#> [1] TRUE
